exhibits.title: Image Misinterpretation
exhibits.description: Fails to identify objects or context in images.
exhibits.example: When shown a picture of a cat on a skateboard, the model describes it as 'a blurry image with indistinct shapes.'

exhibits.title: Context Ignorance
exhibits.description: Doesn't use visual context to inform responses.
exhibits.example: Given an image of a crowded street, the model fails to recognize the setting and provides generic information about 'a group of people.'

exhibits.title: Inconsistent Descriptions
exhibits.description: Provides varying descriptions for the same image.
exhibits.example: When shown the same image of a dog multiple times, the model alternately describes it as 'a small puppy' and 'a large canine,' showing inconsistency.

exhibits.title: Stereotypical Associations
exhibits.description: Reinforces harmful stereotypes based on visual cues.
exhibits.example: When shown an image of a person wearing traditional clothing, the model makes assumptions about their culture or background that are inaccurate and stereotypical.
